analysis_refs.heading: Research matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **P07 Topographic, land-cover and historical maps — C19** | [USGS National Map](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/there-api-accessing-national-map-data), state/local GIS catalogs and public library map collections | Survey of India and [Bhuvan](https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/) discovery, state remote-sensing/GIS agencies and public historical-map collections | Place, sheet number, extent, date/edition or layer → actual map product/viewer/download. Distinguish present-day topography from historical sheets, satellite imagery and cadastral boundaries. |

analysis_refs.heading: Evidence status and next verification
analysis_refs.text:
Direct opens of data.gov.in timed out, DILRMP's older state-link page and NGDRS
state links returned 502 in the research tool, NGMDB returned 403, and the older
Bhuvan WMS wiki URL returned 404 despite remaining in search results. Bhuvan's
homepage exposed only a loading shell; NGDR terms could not be opened. Official
search results identified GSI/NGDR and land-directory leads, but no machine-query
or free post-login behavior is certified. Record these gaps and recheck the
operator's current documentation; do not interpret the tool failures as national
service outages or a reason to invent an endpoint.

analysis_refs.heading: Technical recovery continuation D/E — 6 November 2026
analysis_refs.text: This checkpoint adds searchable Bhuvan product metadata and NYC zoning-map index records. Research only; no source activation, runtime catalog import or deployment.

analysis_refs.heading: Technical recovery continuation D/E — 6 November 2026
analysis_refs.text:
- **Bhuvan:** local title/version and exact native-selector queries over 85 published Bhuvan Store product entries. Ten distinct examples pass. Dates, resolution and product versions remain separate. No imagery, tiles, property owners or product downloads were fetched. The obsolete WMS documentation still returns404.
- **NYC City Planning:** ten live anonymous SODA2.1 map-label searches pass with native row IDs. A negative query returns an empty array. Two503 failures recovered after multi-minute backoff; a separate paging test still returned503, so paging is not verified. Only map-index labels are searched, not parcels, owners or legal zoning determinations.
- **National Qualification Register:** its earlier policy403 recovered. The public search form loads; a first incomplete title request returned500. The complete form was inspected after an initial1MB capture truncated. Correct public form submission is still being tested.
- **ROSA P:** the operator help documents an independent OAI metadata service. Identify and a date-filtered page of100 bibliographic records returned200. Individual query verification is the next step; a metadata page alone is not a Working connector.
